description: Bâtiments 3D 2020 (Maquette LOD2 avec textures) is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. Maquette numérique des bâtiments 3D LOD2 avec textures en format CityGML, 3DM et GDB et en format DWG sans textures de certains arrondissements de Montréal. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. It offers 17 resource(s) in 3DM, DWG, GML. The portal shows 2026-05-04 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
